# Aerocadmy

> Aerocadmy is an online drone technology academy. It teaches how drones work, from components and electronics to programming and flight control, through live classes and hands-on projects.

## Programs

- [Drone Technology Internship](https://www.aerocadmy.com/programs/drone-technology-internship): six-week live online internship with an ESP32 drone kit to keep
- [Courses](https://www.aerocadmy.com/courses): recorded drone technology courses (in development)

## Articles

- [What are the main components of a drone?](https://www.aerocadmy.com/articles/drone-components-for-beginners): beginner's guide to drone hardware and systems
